future_implementation_acceptance_gates: canonicalize implementation source before any Level-1 grant is issued
source ceiling is RECONCILE_ONLY and remains below all signing and submission capabilities
every Level-1 authorization entrypoint consumes a valid current independently verified VerifiedAuthorityGrantV0
missing, expired, SHADOW-only, wrong-commit, wrong-digest, wrong-network, wrong-taker, and wrong-venue grants deny Level 1
RESERVE_CAPITAL is durable local accounting only and has no external effect
the bounded observation adapter has no signer, submission, approval, encoder, private-key, ambient-secret, discovery, or automatic account/asset surface
externally created transactions are represented distinctly from QntySpot-created transactions
existing Program B/B1 chain-truth, ledger, identity, replay, and safe-halt contracts are reused
kill switch and SAFE_HALT preserve observation, decision, chain observation, reconciliation, and quarantine only
no QntyLab, Qnty, or QntyAgentRuntime authority is imported

entrypoints.name: ExecutionRuntime.create_execution_session
entrypoints.requirement: Level-1 sessions admit only after source ceiling and verified external grant intersection

entrypoints.name: ExecutionRuntime.reserve_action
entrypoints.requirement: requires Level-1 authority; local durable reservation only; blocked by kill switch

entrypoints.name: ExecutionRuntime.record_chain_observation
entrypoints.requirement: requires Level-1 OBSERVE_CHAIN and accepts only bounded externally created transaction identity

entrypoints.name: ExecutionRuntime.reconcile_external_action
entrypoints.requirement: requires Level-1 RECONCILE and uses existing canonical chain-truth reconciliation

future_level_1_authorization_entrypoints.record_verified_authority: evidence persistence only; never authority activation

implementation_scope.answer: source-ceiling/authorization wiring plus a new bounded read-only Robinhood-testnet ChainTruthSource/observation adapter
minimum_future_read_only_surface: accept an explicit externally created testnet transaction reference
read only bounded finalized transaction and receipt facts for that reference
emit validated ChainObservationV0 evidence for the existing reconciliation model
fail closed to SAFE_HALT on missing, contradictory, stale, or out-of-scope chain truth
reason: qntyspot/boundary.py defines ChainTruthSource and Reconciler as protocols without an implementation
qntyspot/ledger/execution.py currently requires signed transaction metadata created through the QntySpot B1 path
the current Robinhood adapter is a QuoteSource for the mainnet shadow path, not a testnet ChainTruthSource

reserve_capital.meaning: create or maintain a database reservation needed to account safely for an externally created transaction

qntyspot_must_not: create an approval for the transaction
